title: EC2 Purchasing Options: Savings Plans, RIs & Spot
summary: On-Demand, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Spot, Capacity Reservations and Dedicated Hosts.
tldr: Steady baseline → **commit** (Savings Plans or RIs, 1 or 3 years). Interruptible or fault-tolerant → **Spot**. Short, spiky or unknown → **On-Demand**. Typical answer mixes them: Savings Plan for the baseline, Spot above it.

**Compute Savings Plans** follow you across instance family, size, OS, Region, and into **Fargate and Lambda**. **EC2 Instance Savings Plans** give a deeper discount but lock the family and Region (size, OS and AZ can still change).
Discounts don't guarantee capacity. **On-Demand Capacity Reservations** guarantee capacity in one AZ with no term; pair them with a Savings Plan for the discount.
Per-core or per-socket licenses that can't use shared tenancy → **Dedicated Hosts** with **License Manager**.

keyFacts.text: Spot discount versus On-Demand. AWS can reclaim capacity with a **2-minute** interruption notice, so the workload must checkpoint or be stateless.
Maximum discount of EC2 Instance Savings Plans / Compute Savings Plans versus On-Demand, for a $/hour commitment over 1 or 3 years.
Recommended Spot allocation strategy: picks pools with the most spare capacity at a low price, so interruptions drop. Diversify instance types and AZs.
On-Demand Capacity Reservations reserve capacity in a specific AZ and bill whether used or not; Savings Plans or regional RIs can discount them.
With consolidated billing, Savings Plans and RI discounts apply to matching usage in any account of the organization unless sharing is turned off.

traps: Raising the Spot maximum price does not stop interruptions; capacity reclaim is driven by supply, not your bid.
Dedicated Instances give single-tenant hardware but no visibility of sockets and cores, so they don't satisfy per-core BYOL terms.
Savings Plans and regional RIs give a discount but no capacity guarantee; only zonal RIs or Capacity Reservations reserve capacity.
Buying RIs or Savings Plans for instances that sit idle most of the day locks in waste; stop, schedule or rightsize first.
Savings Plans cannot be shared through AWS RAM or sold on the Reserved Instance Marketplace.
